input.sha256_scope: No image input. Every case is a short string written out in the capture tool, so the expected file is both the input record and the expected record.

upstream.capture_method: The pinned PaddleX formatters were imported and executed, not transcribed.

limitations: The image, chart, formula, and seal formatters are deliberately absent: they depend on P8 modules with no published ONNX export, so a port of them would have nothing to check against.
The numbering pattern is reproduced by a hand-written matcher rather than a regex engine. The sixteen captured title cases are what check it; forms outside that corpus are unverified.
No document is assembled end to end. This pins the per-label formatters, not the ordering or the block extraction that feeds them.
